dedupe_keys.name: eia natural gas data us prices reserves production imports and exports pipelines storage and consumption

description: The natural gas data index of the U.S. Energy Information Administration, read on 2026-09-26, gathers the agency's statistics on US natural gas by topic: summary supply and disposition, prices, exploration and reserves, production, imports and exports, pipelines, storage and consumption. Monthly supply and disposition by state was last released on 31 August 2026, spot and futures prices on 23 September 2026, and the page lists US imports and exports by country, by state, by point of entry and by point of exit, international and interstate movements by state, dry shale gas production by play, drilling activity, plant-level processing capacity (last updated 2019), company-level data from Form EIA-176 and the capacity and location of US LNG export projects. Series are monthly or annual, at US, regional and state level. Tables are browsable on the web and downloadable as XLS, some also as CSV or PDF, free of charge; as US government works they are in the public domain and EIA asks for acknowledgement. Caveats: several reserves and well series stopped between 2020 and 2022, and plant-level data are dated. Simulation uses are calibrating national gas network flow and storage models, border-point import and export flows, and price inputs for capacity planning and resilience studies of gas supply to power plants. Related records: data-eia-us-energy-atlas-and-maps maps pipelines and plants, and data-jodi-gas-world-database gives monthly gas data for other countries.
